# Python side of the image (bin/*.py drivers): every package pinned WITH hashes
# (pip-compile --generate-hashes), transitive ones included, so a build is
# reproducible down to the artifact and `pip-audit -r requirements.txt` (CI)
# covers all of it - the Composer side has `composer audit`, this is its
# counterpart. Regenerate after a deliberate upgrade:
#   grep '==' requirements.txt | sed 's/ \\//;s/ *--hash.*//' > /tmp/requirements.in
#   pipx run --spec pip-tools pip-compile --generate-hashes --no-annotate --no-header \
#       --output-file requirements.txt /tmp/requirements.in
# then re-run the E2E signing tests. Keep pyHanko in lockstep with bin/sign_pdf.py.
